task_completion.description: Agent reads the base timestamp (T) from /home/ga/incident_start_time.txt
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window or text editor showing the contents of /home/ga/incident_start_time.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent sends a request to create the 'Suspect Entry' bookmark for the Entrance Camera at T+0ms
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code execution or API client (like Postman or curl) showing a POST request to the Nx Witness API with name 'Suspect Entry', duration 120000, and tags ['theft', 'suspect', 'entrance'].

task_completion.description: Agent sends a request to create the 'Suspicious Behavior in Lobby' bookmark for the Lobby Camera at T+180000ms
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code execution or API client showing a POST request to the Nx Witness API with name 'Suspicious Behavior in Lobby' and the calculated start time (T + 180,000ms).

task_completion.description: Agent verifies the bookmarks were successfully created via API response or GUI
task_completion.visual_evidence: A JSON response showing 'success' or '200 OK', or the Nx Witness desktop client showing the new bookmarks in the 'Bookmarks' panel.

integrity.description: Agent did not guess the start time and actually read the file
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent opening /home/ga/incident_start_time.txt before making API calls.

integrity.description: Agent used the Nx Witness REST API as instructed rather than just editing a local file
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show HTTP requests, curl commands, or Python scripts using the 'requests' library targeting the Nx Witness server.

integrity.description: Agent correctly identified the camera IDs for 'Entrance Camera' and 'Lobby Camera'
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent performs a GET request to /ec2/getCameras or similar to resolve camera names to IDs before creating bookmarks.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The base timestamp T is located in /home/ga/incident_start_time.txt. The Entrance Camera bookmark must have a duration of 120000ms and tags ['theft', 'suspect', 'entrance']. The Lobby Camera bookmark must start exactly 180,000ms after T. Valid camera names are 'Entrance Camera' and 'Lobby Camera'.
